EC1: [NOT] Failure to have fully recovered (that is, less than or equal to [<=] Grade 1 toxicity) from the reversible effects of prior chemotherapy.
EC2: Major surgery within 14 days before enrollment.
EC3: Radiotherapy within 14 days before enrollment  (if the involved field is small [OR], 7 days will be considered a sufficient interval between treatment and administration of the ixazomib.)
EC5: Infection  requiring systemic antibiotic therapy [OR] or other serious infection within 14 days before study enrollment.
EC6: Evidence of current uncontrolled cardiovascular conditions, including uncontrolled hypertension [OR], uncontrolled cardiac arrhythmias [OR], symptomatic congestive heart failure [OR], unstable angina [OR], or myocardial infarction within the past 6 months.
EC7: Systemic treatment, within 14 days before the first dose of ixazomib, with strong cytochrome P450 3A (CYP3A) inducers (rifampin [OR], rifapentine [OR], rifabutin [OR], carbamazepine [OR], phenytoin [OR], phenobarbital) [OR] , or use of Ginkgo biloba [OR] or St. John's wort.
EC8: Ongoing [OR] or active systemic infection [OR], active hepatitis B [OR] or C virus infection [OR], or known human immunodeficiency virus positive.
EC9: Diagnosed or treated for another malignancy [OR] within 2 years before study enrollment or previously diagnosed with another malignancy and have any evidence of residual disease. Participants with non-melanoma skin cancer [OR] or carcinoma in situ of any type [AND] are [NOT] not excluded if they have undergone complete resection.
EC10: Has greater than or equal to (>=) Grade 2 peripheral neuropathy [OR], or Grade 1 with pain on clinical examination during the screening period.
EC12: Participation in other interventional clinical trials , including those [AND] with other investigational agents not included in this trial, within 30 days of the start of this trial [OR] and throughout the duration of this trial. Non-interventional trials (that is, observational trials) are permitted at any time point.
